promptZh: 从下面七个选项中为五个空格选出最恰当的句子。

explanation.summaryZh: 短文讲述初中生林涛两年来每周六在火车站为老年乘客读报的故事，以及这件事给双方带来的改变。
explanation.ruleZh: 人物故事类七选五按起因、经过、影响展开，注意人物话语与前后动作的呼应。

distractors.reasonZh: 列车班次信息与全文的朗读故事无关。
短文未提他赚钱，且与结尾继续服务的决心矛盾。

sharedOptions.text: One Saturday, Lin Tao simply walked over and asked if he could help.
'They give me far more than I give them,' he says.
The slow train to the city now runs twice a day.
Instead, he sets up a small chair in the waiting room and opens a newspaper.
The listeners especially enjoy news about their hometown.
He used to be too shy to answer questions in front of the class.
Lin Tao hopes to buy a faster bicycle with the money he earns.

segments.text: Every Saturday morning, fourteen-year-old Lin Tao rides his bike to the small railway station in town. He is not there to travel.

For two years, he has spent the morning reading news aloud to older passengers whose eyes are weak.

It started with one man. Grandpa Wang used to sit alone, holding a paper very close to his eyes.

Lin Tao offered to read the sports page, and soon other passengers gathered around to listen.

Now about ten people join the reading circle each week. Lin Tao chooses stories about health, weather and local news.

'He reads slowly and clearly, and repeats anything we miss,' says Grandpa Wang with a proud smile.

Reading aloud has also changed Lin Tao.

His teacher says his writing is full of lively details now, and his confidence in class has grown as well.

Some passengers bring him eggs or home-grown vegetables, which he politely shares with the listeners.
Lin Tao says he will continue until he leaves town for senior high school.

gaps.label: 第1空
gaps.clue: 不是去坐车，那去干什么
gaps.explanationZh: 前句说他不是去坐车，o4 用 Instead 转折说明他真正的安排，与后句坚持两年读报衔接。

gaps.label: 第2空
gaps.explanationZh: 前句写王爷爷独自看报吃力，o1 写林涛主动上前询问，自然引出后句主动读体育版。

gaps.label: 第3空
gaps.explanationZh: 前句说他挑选健康新闻、天气和本地新闻，o5 听众最爱家乡消息与之呼应，再接引语。

gaps.label: 第4空
gaps.explanationZh: 前句总说朗读也改变了林涛自己，o6 写他过去胆小，后句老师评价写作与自信的变化形成对比。

gaps.label: 第5空
gaps.explanationZh: 前句写乘客送鸡蛋蔬菜，o2 用他自己的话他们给我的更多回应，后句说他将继续坚持。
